labels.label: lem:kobayashi
labels.notes: Unmarked in every touched file: none of the eight has a match of the ledger's mark regex (tools/ledger.py:247), and each one carries the label as plain `lem:kobayashi` — `Yamabegap.tex:613` where it cites it. The integration changes no lem:kobayashi statement. The five lem:kobayashi declarations it renames (Mfd.eLpNorm_gradNorm_lt_top, Mfd.sobolev_embedding, Mfd.Reads.sobolevIneq, Mfd.Reads.kobayashiB, Mfd.Reads.prop_nonpositive_csc) have, under their round-1 names, exactly the types of the sorry'd round-1 originals at 1034b2b (see type_probe). So the faithfulness reading of AUDIT-1 and AUDIT-2 (Lean ≥ paper under OQ-93 (a), (b)) carries over unchanged. All five are now sorry-free with standard axioms. The row stays partial while OQ-93 is open, which is correct.

labels.label: lem:positivity
labels.notes: Unmarked, which is correct: Mfd.rellich_kondrachov is still a sorry, and OQ-93 is open. Mfd.trace_embedding and Mfd.Reads.traceIneq have exactly their 1034b2b types. THE REPAIR. Exactly two statements change. (1) The value of MeasuredModel.ConstLimit gains one non-dependent binder `MemLp f 2 (M.vol g)`, placed after f. (2) The type of Mfd.const_of_tendsto gains one, `(hf : MemLp f 2 μ)`, also after f. Delete that binder and each is the 1034b2b form, as an Expr (type_probe). The reading is faithful to l.720: there the limit is the u_∞ of W^{1,2}(Σ) ⊂ L²(Σ), obtained from Rellich–Kondrachov in L². On the model, MeasuredModel.lem_positivity applies ConstLimit only to the RellichProp limit. It now keeps that limit's MemLp component (`hfm`, previously discarded by `-`) and passes it on. RellichProp is unchanged. CONSUMERS. The scaffold constants whose type mentions ConstLimit are MeasuredModel.lem_positivity, MeasuredModel.cor_negative_of_analytic, MeasuredModel.cor_negative_of_externals, toy_constLimit, toyCut_not_constLimit and Mfd.Reads.constLimit. The first three take ConstLimit as a hypothesis, and their type is unchanged as an Expr, so each is now strictly stronger. toyCut_not_constLimit refutes the weaker Prop, so it is stronger too: `ConstLimit` still carries the connectedness. toy_constLimit and Mfd.Reads.constLimit conclude the weaker Prop, and that is the repair itself. AUDIT-2 showed the old Reads.constLimit false; the new one is proved from Mfd.Reads.constLimit_of_aestronglyMeasurable at MemLp.aestronglyMeasurable. Mfd.const_of_tendsto is proved from Mfd.const_of_tendsto_of_aestronglyMeasurable. Asking MemLp rather than AEStronglyMeasurable is the dispatch's choice, and it matches the paper's u_∞ ∈ L². Mfd.Reads.lem_positivity, Mfd.Reads.cor_negative and Mfd.lem_positivity keep their 1034b2b types, and they now reach sorryAx only through Mfd.rellich_kondrachov.

type_probe.method: I extracted the eight 1034b2b scaffold files with `git show 1034b2b:lean-yamabe/scaffold/YamabeScaffold/<F>.lean` into a temporary module tree AuditOld.* under /tmp, changing only line 1 (import YamabeScaffold.X became import AuditOld.X), and compiled them with `lake env lean --root … -o`. The strict Yamabe.* they import is the 1034b2b one: `git log 1034b2b..HEAD -- lean-yamabe` and `git diff --stat HEAD -- lean-yamabe/Yamabe` are both empty. The old build gave round 1's six `declaration uses sorry` warnings (Sobolev 374, 387; Trace 398, 411; Rellich 469, 481). In each environment, the old one (AuditOld.*) and the working tree (import YamabeScaffold), a dump recorded, for every non-internal constant of the scaffold modules: name, kind, level parameters, module, and the `repr` of its type with binder names erased (binder infos, mdata and levels kept), plus the value for every def. A Python diff compared the two dumps.
type_probe.result: There are 326 old constants and 319 new ones. Present only in 1034b2b: the seven primes. Present only in the working tree: none. Of the 319 common constants, all have the same kind and the same level parameters. Exactly one type differs, Yamabe.Mfd.const_of_tendsto, and exactly one def value differs, Yamabe.MeasuredModel.ConstLimit. The seven renamed theorems (Mfd.eLpNorm_gradNorm_lt_top [u_1], Mfd.sobolev_embedding [u_1], Mfd.trace_embedding [u_1], Mfd.Reads.sobolevIneq [u_1,u_2], Mfd.Reads.kobayashiB [u_1,u_2], Mfd.Reads.prop_nonpositive_csc [u_1,u_2], Mfd.Reads.traceIneq [u_1,u_2]) are identical to their deleted 1034b2b originals, and to the 1034b2b primes. They moved from Sobolev/Trace to ManifoldTheorems. A second probe deleted the single non-dependent `∀ _ : MeasureTheory.MemLp …` binder from the new const_of_tendsto type and from the new ConstLimit value. Both then equal the 1034b2b strings, after whitespace normalisation. As a sanity check, the unstripped new and old strings differ. `#check` and `#print` show the new binders as `MemLp f 2 μ` and `MemLp f 2 (M.vol g)`.
type_probe.verdict: The INTEGRATE-R2 claims hold. The renames keep the types unchanged, and the only statement changes are the two MemLp additions. My check is stronger than the closer's, which covered 24 declarations; this one covers all 319 constants of the scaffold.

build.axioms: standard (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) for every scaffold constant, except six that rest on sorryAx: the two sorrys and four of their dependents
build.details: GATE. Before running it I checked with `pgrep -af lake`: no `lake build` was running in lean-yamabe (the only Lean process was another agent's `lake env lean` in lean-gx). `taskset -c 0-11 make -C lean-yamabe check` printed `lake build Yamabe`: Build completed successfully (8565 jobs). `lake build YamabeScaffold`: Build completed successfully (8575 jobs), with only two warnings, `declaration uses sorry` at Trace.lean:407 and Rellich.lean:481. `scripts/sorry_count.py`: strict 0, scaffold 2 (Rellich.lean 1, Trace.lean 1). `AxiomSweep`: 538 strict and 424 scaffold declarations, all standard except 6 scaffold declarations resting on a sorry. Final line: `lean-yamabe: all gates green`. The oleans are newer than their sources. `taskset -c 0-11 lake env lean` from source exits 0 on each of the eight changed files, with warnings only at the two sorrys. SORRY. In code: Rellich.lean:486 (Mfd.rellich_kondrachov) and Trace.lean:412 (Mfd.trace_compact). Every other occurrence of the word is in a docstring or comment. There is no admit, axiom, native_decide, set_option, extern, implemented_by, opaque or unsafe in the scaffold. AXIOMS. The probe `campaign/T-yamabe-analysis/AuditProbeIntegrateR2.lean` (deleted afterwards) gave `#print axioms`: Mfd.sobolev_embedding, Mfd.trace_embedding, MeasuredModel.lem_positivity and Mfd.Reads.constLimit are [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; Mfd.Reads.lem_positivity is [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Standard as well: Mfd.eLpNorm_gradNorm_lt_top, Mfd.Reads.{sobolevIneq, kobayashiB, prop_nonpositive_csc, traceIneq}, Mfd.const_of_tendsto, MeasuredModel.cor_negative_of_{analytic,externals}, toy_constLimit, toyCut_not_constLimit, toy_lem_positivity, Mfd.not_const_of_tendsto. With sorryAx: Mfd.Reads.rellichProp, Mfd.Reads.cor_negative, Mfd.lem_positivity, Mfd.rellich_kondrachov, Mfd.trace_compact. A sweep of `Lean.collectAxioms` over all 319 non-internal scaffold constants found exactly six with a non-standard axiom, sorryAx: trace_compact, rellich_kondrachov, Reads.rellichProp, Reads.lem_positivity, Reads.cor_negative, Mfd.lem_positivity. A dependency walk over types and values, with rellich_kondrachov and trace_compact treated as opaque leaves, shows that those four dependents reach sorryAx only through rellich_kondrachov. Reads.constLimit uses neither leaf, and no scaffold constant uses trace_compact. This matches INTEGRATE-R2's six constants and its 6 → 2.

scope.note: In scope. The other modified paths in the checkout (papers/egf/programme, programme/, roadmap/roadmap.toml, lean-benzecri, lean-causal, lean-gx) belong to other loops. The text diff agrees with the type probe. Sobolev and Trace have docstrings and deletions only, plus one docstring of trace_critical. ManifoldTheorems has the renames, docstrings, and the removal of `universe u v` and the seven rfl examples; level parameters are unchanged. Compactness has docstrings and one identifier inside a proof (eLpNorm_gradNorm_lt_top' → eLpNorm_gradNorm_lt_top). External, HalfSpace and Localisation each have one docstring line. docstring_contract: All eight touched files have a title, their labels unmarked with Yamabegap.tex lines in the first 4000 characters (lem:kobayashi 613, lem:positivity 715; External also prop:nonpositive 476, lem:gluing-estimate 648, thm:upper-bound 493, cor:negative 502), a `## Hypothesis checklist`, a `## SCOPE (disclosed)` and the provenance line. No file has a `**`label`**` mark. I checked these claims after the change, and they are true: Sobolev has 'no sorry in this file' and its checklist row points to Mfd.Reads.sobolevIneq/Mfd.sobolev_embedding in ManifoldTheorems. Trace says '`Mfd.trace_compact` only; nothing proved depends on it', and the dependency walk confirms that nothing uses it. ManifoldTheorems has 'What is proved', 'Provenance of the statements' (the Expr-equality claim matches my probe) and a SCOPE naming the two remaining sorrys, neither of which the file uses. Rellich has 'What is stated with sorry: Mfd.rellich_kondrachov' and the new checklist row reading u_∞ as a limit in L² (`MemLp f 2`, OQ-93 (c)). Its SCOPE records the repair accurately and describes `Mfd.const_of_tendsto` as proved without weak derivatives. External's row says SobolevIneq and TraceIneq are sorry-free, ConstLimit is sorry-free on a reading model, and RellichProp comes from the sorry'd rellich_kondrachov. The pointer lines in HalfSpace and Localisation are true. AUDIT-2 findings 1–2 stay fixed: no `const_of_tendsto_counterexample` remains, and Localisation says Rellich is not localised. Every line number INTEGRATE-R2 cites matches the files (ManifoldTheorems 82/97/113/146/162/171/180, Rellich 118/481/496/539, Trace 407, Compactness 933/985/1044). One SCOPE sentence in Compactness is imprecise (finding 1).
finding_check: The integration claims no new finding about the paper. The round-2 finding on the round-1 Lean, Mfd.not_const_of_tendsto, is kept, and its type is identical to 1034b2b by the probe. With the repair it now refutes only the deleted statement and no live declaration: the repaired Mfd.const_of_tendsto and MeasuredModel.ConstLimit carry the MemLp hypothesis that its witness f = 1_S lacks.

findings.what: The SCOPE says '`ConstLimit` and `Mfd.const_of_tendsto` now ask `MemLp f 2`, and are proved from `Mfd.Reads.constLimit_of_aestronglyMeasurable` and `Mfd.const_of_tendsto_of_aestronglyMeasurable` (`YamabeScaffold.Rellich`)'. MeasuredModel.ConstLimit is a Prop of a model and is not proved in general; toyCut_not_constLimit refutes it. What is proved is Mfd.Reads.constLimit, ConstLimit on a model reading M. The parenthetical also reads as if the two `_of_aestronglyMeasurable` theorems were in Rellich, but they are in this file. At :931, 'the repaired `Mfd.const_of_tendsto` … is this theorem' overstates: the repaired theorem is its corollary through MemLp.aestronglyMeasurable. Rellich.lean's SCOPE says both things correctly.
